definitions.item_frac: ||P (h - mu_LOTO)||^2 / ||P h||^2, mu_LOTO = mean over renders of the other 47 tables
definitions.delta_share: ||P (h_m - h_p)||^2 / ||h_m - h_p||^2 over the 183 member-partner pairs
definitions.reader_visible_ratio: ||unit(P h_m) - unit(P h_p)|| / ||unit(h_m) - unit(h_p)|| (readers rescale their input)
definitions.PCA_k: 004-style within-table PCA (centred within table, rows / sqrt(n_t)), cross-fitted over 4 table folds; k chosen as the smallest k whose pooled held-out median delta_share >= the J piece's (PCA_k_delta) or whose item_held >= the J piece's (PCA_k_item)
definitions.mean_removed: I - u u^T, u = unit(mu_LOTO) (rank-1 removal of the other tables' mean direction)
definitions.z_probe: exploratory: 12-way logistic (C 0.05, standardised) on unit(P h), folds = 4 table folds; control = whole tables' label sets permuted (2 draws)
